subject: Capacity bridging authorization request — Lynx Systems (late-stage)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-06T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick check — Lynx late-stage capacity ask (pre-authorization)

Team,

Lynx Systems (contact: Emma Park) moved into final procurement and is requesting dedicated capacity for their flagship model evaluation. Summary: pilot to start in early Dec, estimated baseline steady-state inference ~120M tokens/day, burst profile equivalent to ~20 A100-80GB GPUs (or H100 equivalent) for 4–6 weeks during ramp. They want a hold on capacity until they sign PO — asking that we reserve capacity from Nov 10 through Dec 18 if possible.

Can ops confirm current available headroom in US-west and whether a 30-day soft hold (non-binding, refundable) for 20 A100-equivalents is feasible? If we can’t meet full equivalence, please provide suggested fallback (mixed instance + quantized pools) and any expected latency delta. I’ve attached the capacity spec and the draft MAP.

Give me a pulse by EOD today — need to feed this into the commercial terms we’ll send to procurement.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: lynx_capacity_spec_20281106.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-06T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick check — Lynx late-stage capacity ask (pre-authorization)

Vivek — thanks for the heads up. I pulled the current inventory and ran a short availability delta for Nov/Dec. Short summary:

- Raw headroom (US-west cluster): ~18 x A100-80GB equivalents immediately available; additional 12 convertible H100 slots that require driver/stack prep (~48–72h).
- Long-term committed pools already scheduled for Nov–Jan reduce free capacity; if we grant a soft hold we will need to mark instances as reserved in the scheduler to avoid double-alloc.
- Suggested fallback: 12 dedicated A100 equiv + 8 mixed-quantized nodes (NVL/INT8) — expect ~12–20% tail latency increase on max-length requests vs pure A100.

Operations can offer a 14-day soft hold without exec sign-off. Anything longer (30 days or a hard escrow) requires Ops+Finance approval because it impacts our on-demand buffer for enterprise bursts.

I’m attaching the inventory snapshot and a short note on expected latency deltas for the mixed profile. If you want me to pre-stage H100 images we can do that, but it will consume the driver prep window and block ~10% of our patching cadence.

—Marissa
Product Ops — Serving Runtime

Attachments: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20281106.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma@lynxsys.com>, procurement@lynxsys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-07T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick check — Lynx late-stage capacity ask (pre-authorization)

Emma — forwarding our internal availability note so you have visibility into what ops is seeing. TL;DR: we can cover most of the requested baseline but will likely need to mix in quantized nodes unless Lynx is flexible on latency during peak bursts.

Two asks for you so we can firm this up:
1) Can you confirm preferred pilot start date (Lynx previously mentioned early Dec but we need a firm start window)?
2) If you need a 30-day reservation window, can you flag whether that will be part of the PO or a separate prepayment? That determines whether we pursue a soft hold or an escrow-style commitment.

I’ve attached a draft MAP that outlines milestones and expected traffic ramp.

Best,
Vivek

Attachments: lynx_map_v1.docx

From: Emma Park <emma@lynxsys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lynxsys.com
Date: 2028-11-08T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick check — Lynx late-stage capacity ask (pre-authorization)

Vivek — thanks for sending this through and for the transparency. Confirming: Lynx plans to start the pilot week of Dec 4 (expected heavy ramp Dec 11–18). We need the ability to run the pilot through Dec 18 before final sign-off. Procurement is evaluating a 30-day reservation and has asked for a pricing quote that assumes a soft hold from Nov 10–Dec 18.

Procurement will issue a PO stub if the terms are acceptable; attaching the stub now (non-final).

Two quick questions for Redwood ops:
- If you offer mixed-quantized fallback, can you provide an SLO for P95 latency during peak?
- What is the policy on rolling back reserved instances if our ramp slips by >7 days?

Appreciate the quick coordination.

—Emma Park
Lynx Systems

Attachments: lynx_po_stub_20281108.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-08T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick check — Lynx late-stage capacity ask (pre-authorization)

Vivek / Marissa — we should approve a 30-day soft hold for 20 A100-equivalents but structure it as a refundable prepayment to cover the opportunity cost. Finance: can we waive the refund penalty if Lynx slips <7 days? Sergio, can you run the economics (unit cost vs lost on-demand revenue) and propose the dollar amount? If we do staged holds (first 14 days soft, then extend to full 30 with prepay) that gives us flexibility.

Also — make sure the routing policy includes automatic fallback to the mixed-quantized pool after X% utilization to protect other enterprise customers.

-Karthik
Head of Commercial Ops

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Emma Park <emma@lynxsys.com>
Date: 2028-11-09T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Decision: approve 30-day soft hold (bridge) for Lynx — action items

Folks — thanks for the quick turn. Decision summary and next steps:

Decision: Approve a 30-day "soft hold (bridge)" covering 20 A100-equivalents starting Nov 10 and running through Dec 9. This will be governed by a refundable prepayment (terms to be drafted by Finance). We will offer the mixed-quantized fallback for up to 40% of capacity during peak windows; P95 SLO for mixed profile will be provided by Marissa (expected delta 15–18%).

Action items:
- Marissa: mark 20 A100-equiv as reserved in the scheduler and prepare H100 pre-staging plan (if Lynx elects it) — due: Nov 11 EOD.
- Sergio: economics and suggested refundable prepayment amount for 30-day bridge — due: Nov 10 noon.
- Karthik: update commercial terms and add refundable prepayment clause to the PO template — due: Nov 10 EOD.
- Vivek: send formal terms to Emma / procurement and request PO confirmation.

Emma — we will proceed to mark the soft hold tomorrow morning. Can you please confirm by COB Nov 10 if Lynx wants H100 pre-staging or if mixed nodes are acceptable?

Thanks all — let’s keep the ops ticket number in the thread once created.

Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
